decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development is not considered to preserve or enhance Turnham Green Conservation Area, by way of the infilling of the basement and ground floor area, and the visual intrusion of the proposed walkway and ventilation, contrary to policy ENV-B 2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.        The proposed use of the roof of the extension for a walkway and access to a new door would result in undue noise and disturbance, and loss of privacy, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining neighbouring residents, contrary to the provision of Policies ENV-B 1.1 and ENV P 1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Insufficient information has been submitted of the proposed kitchen and basement extension area and ventilation duct to show that the operation of the enlarged restaurant and proposed ventilation would have due regard to the amenities of surrounding residents, contrary to policy ENV B 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Proposed change of use to restaurant that will close at 7pm, erection of a single storey rear infill extension, demolition of existing pitched roof and installation of new walkway and door to give rear access to first floor.
